text: 央行明确下半年八项重点工作，货币政策想象空间打开 市场分析认为，下半年逆周期调节力度有望加码，各类货币政策工具已进入灵活启用的待命状态。
text_en: PBOC outlines eight key tasks for H2, opening up room for monetary policy maneuvers — Market analysts suggest counter-cyclical adjustments are likely to be intensified in H2, with various monetary policy tools on standby for flexible activation.
